market_summary: Across all six instruments during the London session, markets are characterized by tight mean-reverting consolidation inside session Value Areas and directly around Point of Control (POC) levels. XAUUSD, XAGUSD, and BTCUSD are pinned near their respective POCs with low RVOL and subdued volume. EURUSD and GBPUSD show slight upward probes toward Value Area Highs but suffer from bearish or neutral CVD divergence and lack RVOL > 2.0 breakout backing. US100 bounced off its London Session Low but remains suppressed below VWAP and EMA50. With no high-conviction breakout confluence or NY session participation, disciplined risk management dictates HOLD across all symbols.

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 3884.20 to VAH 3911.53) and hovering right at POC 3896.98. CVD is BEARISH at -2.04 with a mild positive slope (0.14), showing a lack of committed directional conviction. In the LONDON_SESSION, price is trading below session VWAP (3902.43) and below EMA50 (3900.73), both acting as dynamic overhead resistance. Price sits mid-channel within the ATR envelope (3884.26 to 3914.66). RVOL is low at 0.689 with no yellow breakout confirmation bars. Price is capped below S/R 3922.99 (Session High) and well above support S/R 3887.45. Options GEX is null outside NY cash hours. Given the low-volume fair-value compression directly on POC, conditions dictate a disciplined HOLD.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10560 to VAH 1.10636) with the signal candle closing below POC 1.10598 while live price tests VAH at 1.10634. CVD is NEUTRAL at +3,724 with an accelerating positive slope (2,233.65), showing mixed market pressure. Operating in the LONDON_SESSION, price is hovering right on VWAP (1.10595) and coiling tightly around EMA50 (1.10607), reflecting no established structural trend. ATR band position is mid-channel between lower 1.10502 and upper 1.10713. RVOL stands at 1.598, lacking the required yellow RVOL > 2.0 breakout spike. Overhead resistance sits at S/R 1.10662 and Session High 1.10726, with support at S/R 1.10574. GEX is null. With price trapped inside value and lacking breakout confirmation, a HOLD is warranted.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32276 to VAH 1.32378) with signal candle below POC 1.32349, though live price pushes slightly above VAH toward S/R 1.32391 and Session High 1.32431. Crucially, CVD is BEARISH at -3,719 with a negative slope (-236.46), presenting a severe divergence against the upward price push. In the LONDON_SESSION, price is slightly above flat VWAP (1.32326) and EMA50 (1.32346). Price is approaching the upper ATR band (1.32448). Volume confirmation is absent with RVOL at 0.788 (no yellow bars). Overhead resistance at S/R 1.32391 and Session High 1.32431 looms with no volume or delta backing. GEX is null. Clear divergence and resistance proximity mandate a HOLD.

Price trades inside the Value Area (VAL 28159.05 to VAH 28405.33) and remains well below POC 28264.08. CVD is BEARISH at -2.32 with a declining slope (-0.77), agreeing with the broader downward pressure. In the LONDON_SESSION, price trades firmly below declining VWAP (28319.70) and EMA50 (28276.50). ATR position is mid-channel between 28137.42 and 28346.95. RVOL is 0.926; while US100 CFD volume rarely prints yellow bars, there is still no structural breakout setup. The signal candle swept Session Low (28151.81) and bounced, but is now encountering immediate resistance at S/R 28209.17 and EMA20 (28242.18). GEX is null ahead of the NY cash open. Without NY liquidity or clean trend continuation, HOLD is the appropriate action.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 49.748 to VAH 50.470) and consolidating immediately above POC 49.928. CVD is BEARISH at -105.5 with a negative slope (-17.29), indicating persistent sell pressure despite minor intrabar bouncing. In the LONDON_SESSION, price remains capped below downward-sloping VWAP (50.202) and EMA50 (50.183). ATR position is mid-channel between lower band 49.691 and upper band 50.405. RVOL is 1.184 with no yellow breakout confirmation bars. Immediate support is at S/R 49.922 with deeper support at Prev Low 49.688 and Session Low 49.579, while resistance sits at S/R 50.313. GEX is null. Pinned at fair value with conflicting price/delta action, the setup is a clear HOLD.

Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 67782.90 to VAH 70190.61) and hugging session POC 68676.09. CVD is BEARISH at -0.05 with a flat slope (0.0). In the LONDON_SESSION, price is trading well below VWAP (69407.78) and structural baseline EMA50 (69749.52). ATR band position is mid-channel between 68182.98 and 69605.45.
